Definition: Azmaveth, the name of three Israelites and of a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Azmaveth = "strong unto death"; n pr m; 1) one of David's mighty warriors; 2) a descendant of Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan and grandson of king Saul; 3) a Benjamite, father of Jeziel and Pelet who were two of David's men who joined him at Ziklag; 4) overseer of the royal treasures in the reign of David; n pr loc; 5) a place in Benjamin; also 'Beth-azmeveth'
